## s12-v03 — argument map

How could things come to be (kathaṃ te jāyeran), and how reach Your path of vision (darśanapathaṃ vrajeyuḥ)? Inlaid by what great nature-limb (kenāpi prakṛtimahatāṅkena khacitaḥ)? Rising and rising (tathotthāyotthāya), from land-water-grass on (sthalajalatṛṇāder), You scatter nectar-floods of creation over all things (padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair vikirasi).

### Open
- Whether 'prakṛtimahatāṅkena' means 'by what great nature-limb' or 'by what great limb of nature' is unresolved.
- Whether 'padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair' is one compound or several is unresolved (kept as printed).
- GRETIL prints (?) after padārthadyānsṛṣṭisravadamṛtapūrair — editorial doubt on the compound's extent; cite kept byte-exact, reading accepted pending collation.
